{{Quote|I am Ozurist, the chief engineer. I serve the great machines, the true rulers of Coruscant.|Ozurist|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Ozurist''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A chief [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who was employed in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] throughout much of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the Cold War, Ozurist developed a strong devotion to both his fellow biologicals and the machines he served. During the Cold War, Ozurist asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-allied individual for help saving one of the "great machines" from destruction by rogue [[Droid/Legends|droids]] known as "[[mobile]]s."

==Biography==
{{Quote|That machine is more alive than we are, and now he will live on&mdash;thanks to you.|Ozurist|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], Ozurist lived on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the Cold War, he worked as chief [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]], the heart of Coruscant's [[Industrial District/Legends|Industrial District]]. Ozurist believed that the "great machines" as he called them&mdash;the giant machines and [[Computer/Legends|computers]] that comprised Coruscant's infrastructure&mdash;were alive.<ref name="TOR" />

After the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] by the Sith Empire and the widespread devastation it caused, much of the planet's infrastructure was heavily damaged, and the [[Programmer/Legends|programming]] of many of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in The Works became corrupted. These droids went rogue and attacked any living being that entered The Works. They became so much of a threat that the Republic was forced to send [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] down into The Works to [[Ground warfare/Legends|combat]] the droids.<ref name="TOR" />

These droids, known to Ozurist and the "great machines" as "[[mobile]]s," believed that they should [[Death/Legends|kill]] all living beings on Coruscant and rule the planet themselves. However, the "great machines" disagreed, as their programming was still intact. In [[3643 BBY]], several of the droids damaged the machine Ozurist called [[Thermodraft]], intending to cause a massive explosion and a [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] leak that would kill an untold number of civilians.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Ozurist asked a Republic combatant to enter The Works and save Thermodraft, so as to prevent the disaster. That individual ventured into The Works, braving attacks from rogue droids and the savage, native [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] known as [[Cthon/Legends|Cthon]], and was able to release the control valves on Thermodraft. That released the pent-up pressure, fixing the machine and preventing the explosion. The individual then returned to Ozurist and informed him of their success. Ozurist thanked them for their help and their service to the great ones.<ref name="TOR" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I heard his cries grow silent. Tell me that means you saved him&mdash;tell me the great Thermodraft lives on.|Ozurist|<ref name="TOR" />}}
As a [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] Lethan Twi'lek, Ozurist was one of the red-skinned members of his species. Ozurist was seen as slightly insane by the individual who aided him, as he considered the machines of the undercity to be alive. That, combined with his role as an engineer, developed into a heartfelt devotion to the machines that Ozurist considered his masters. That devotion, however, did not prevent Ozurist for feeling empathy towards his fellow biologicals&mdash;Ozurist feared that Thermodraft's destruction would result in catastrophic loss of life, something that he believed should be prevented at all costs.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ozurist appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] (MMORPG) released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He gives players the optional mission "Meltdown!" in the Works on Coruscant, where he asks the player character to travel deeper into the Works and release the pressure valves.<ref name="TOR" />

As Coruscant is the Republic capital, the quest is only available to the four Republic classes: [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]], [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]], [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|trooper]], and [[Voidhound|smuggler]]. Unlike many quests in the game, "Meltdown!" does not feature any [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] or [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] choices for the player. The player may choose different conversation options, but the different options do not have any effect on the course of the quest, unless the player chooses to decline the quest.<ref name="TOR" />
